sentences: Make- Out with Violence is a 2008 film directed by the Deagol Brothers, their first feature- length film.
Drive Hard( originally titled Hard Drive) is a 2014 Australian direct- to- video action buddy film directed by Brian Trenchard- Smith and written by Chad Law, Evan Law, and Smith.
A professional thief( John Cusack) takes a former race car driver( Thomas Jane) hostage and forces him to drive his getaway car.
To Paint or Make Love is a 2005 French film directed by Arnaud Larrieu and Jean- Marie Larrieu.
The film was nominated for the Palme d' Or at the 2005 Cannes Film Festival.
Royal Tramp II is a 1992 Hong Kong film based on Louis Cha's novel" The Deer and the Cauldron".
The film is a sequel to" Royal Tramp", which was released earlier in the same year.
Viuuulentemente mia(" Mine with violence") is a 1982 Italian crime comedy film written and directed by Carlo Vanzina.
